sources.type: REST API, no key (FFATA subaward reports; snapshot only)

tested.name: WisDOT SFY25 consultant contracts / work orders by project (PDF)
tested.fields: Region, Project ID, WO, Highway, Project limit, County, Contract function (e.g. Design Services, Hydraulic Analysis and Design S…), Auth date, Vendor, Project costs (the authorized amount).
tested.finding: 1,055 awarded work orders, $308,373,601 total. 26 lines mention drainage / hydraulic / storm / culvert; the largest drainage-named amount is $285,591 (Storm Water Management Statewide / Drainage Studies work orders). Far below $5M. Awards only, so it could only feed the awards tab. Not built in: needs pdftotext (poppler) in the workflow.

tested.name: FDOT Internet Reports (Consultant Acquisition Plan, Active and Expired Contracts, Final Selections)

tested.finding: Direct export URLs (rs:Format=CSV) returned HTTP 500 without the interactive report parameters, and the report viewer is a script-driven page. Not usable without a browser session; not built in.
